title: Modern Event Deck 2014: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "One does not question the size or shape of the grains of sand in an hourglass. Nor do I question the temperament of the souls under my guidance."
You will scream out your innermost secrets just to make it stop.
Together the soldiers were like a golden blade, cutting down their enemies and scarring the darkness.
In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.
"The nim raid our homes without warning. We must defend our homes without hesitation."
"Jharic returned from Grixis changed, a haunted look in her eyes. She destroyed them with an unholy glee that made me shudder." —Knight-Captain Wyhorn
The murdered inhabitants of Hollowhenge impart to the living the terror they felt in death.
"I need never remember my past associates, my victims, my mistakes. Innistrad preserves them all for me." —Sorin Markov
"There is much to learn here, but few can endure the ringing of the spires." —Nulakam the Archivist
Not every church is a place of faith.
"For centuries my creation kept this world in balance. Now only her shadow remains." —Sorin Markov
Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.
"We are a clachan of smiths. The forge is as comfortable to us as a small fire during a cool winter's evening."
"It hurts more if you think about it." —Hooks, Cabal torturer
"Before the war, we prayed to Kataki to sharpen our swords and harden our armor. Without his blessing our weapons are all but useless against the kami hordes." —Kenzo the Hardhearted
"You serve Phyrexia. Your pieces would better serve Phyrexia elsewhere." —Azax-Azog, the Demon Thane
